reviews.text: These folks are awesome!! I’ve been going to them for several years now. The location is terrific, the people there are super friendly, very obviously dog lovers. Their prices are reasonable & fair. The facility is clean & well presented. One day, I had a last minute need for a bath for my fur baby. They worked her in  & as usual did a fantastic job. You won’t go wrong taking your baby to these wonderful folks.
Happy puppy by a wonderful staff! Thank you!! ❤️❤️❤️
Holly was beautiful, as always. Would never take he anywhere else. Groomers are fantastic!!

I have been bringing my schnauzer, Reznor to White Rock Grooming since he was a baby. Being a schnauzer, Reznor is a challenge to groom, especially his feet. The groomers have always been patient and caring towards his special needs and they greet and treat him like family when we arrive. Even after moving 30 miles away, I still drive the miles to get my fur son his spa day. Thank you White Rock Grooming for being so good at what you do. We love you.
Always a great experience. Professional, friendly and knowledgeable staff!
I have been going here for a minute. Service is always great. Love how my dogs feel after grooming.

Peaches look’s so beautiful!!!! She is 16 and they handle her so well and with great care. When I took peaches to other grooming places she always shivered and looked scared. She doesn’t react this way when she goes to white rock grooming. If you have an older dog take them here, they know how to handle older dogs.

Our little Emma enjoyed her "spaw" day at White Rock Pet Grooming.  And I appreciate staffer Dorothy quickly a d safely trimming the nails on Nova 6 Toes. We adopted her a year ago and she is touchy about her toes being touched but Dorothy is building trust with Nova who happily accepted treats from her after her "mani-pedi" trim.
Always a great experience!

Our dogs love it here- the staff is professional and kind and the dogs get the best baths and grooming care at a very affordable price! They look AND smell pretty instead of lwet dogs like when I drop them off

Now that she has crossed that rainbow bridge, I have an Airdelle Puppy and he is getting the same incredible treatment! As long as I live in Dallas, I will be a White Rock Pet Grooming Customer! Try them out and you won’t regret it!
Thank you for the 5-Star review!
such a good job on my boy!

They do fine, and our dogs don't freak out entering, so they must handle them well. My only criticism is they do what they want, not necessarily what you ask for, but grace is given because my dogs aren't exactly easy to manage.

We love White Rock Pet Grooming and so does our dog.
We feel so fortunate to find the most wonderful groomers and loving staff.

White Rock pet grooming always leaves my pups looking absolutely gorgeous and they truly know how to give a quality cut based on the coat of the dog. Knowing that my dogs both have undercoats, they NEVER apply shears to their actual fur and use scissors so their fur keeps the integrity! Bear and Ted always come home so soft, clean, and genuinely much happier to get all their excess shed removed.
My dog is very nervous about going in anywhere. The staff here makes my pup feel at ease. The groom job is wonderful. Looks like a show dog
I love this place! They take care of my baby so well ❤️ thank y’all for being awesome!!
My rescue (often skittish) loves going for her spa day - gets excited when we pull in and no fear! Love the text communications too.

They consistently do a great job but, equally important to me is that Bella feels comfortable here. Usually, at any groomer, vet, or pet store, she is running for the door. When she gets here she peeks behind the counter and rolls over to get a belly rub!

Great service! Everything I was looking for in a local groomer. My baby boy Bruce went in very easily and left so happy and looking great! I have a 140 lb German shepherd and they took great care of him! I mean look how clean those ears are!! 10/10 stars.

White Rock Grooming always takes such wonderful care of my sweet Luna. She is 14 years old and blind, so finding a groomer I completely trust is incredibly important. They are always so patient, gentle, and kind with her, and she comes home looking absolutely beautiful every time.

I’ve driven by White Rock Pet Grooming for years; after reading numerous great reviews I decided to try them for my 3-legged rescue dog. I was impressed with the quick response and scheduling of an appointment that wasn’t months away. The intake was flawless and I was heard about specific things I wanted addressed during his grooming. What a wonderful surprise and experience when I picked him up a couple hours later. He looked PERFECT!!!!  Highly recommend—and the place was spotless inside and out. What a hidden little gem in East Dallas.

The only place I’ll ever take my doggo until the end of time I LOVE the entire team so much! Been taking my boy here for five years and they are full of so much love, patience, care, and every single cut is absolute perfection. A million stars for this hardworking team!!  Best place in DFW

.

We had such a wonderful experience with our groomer! Our dachshund and miniature schnoodle both came home looking absolutely amazing and so happy. Anyone with a dachshund knows how sensitive they can be, and our mini schnoodle can be a little anxious during grooming appointments, but the staff was incredibly patient, gentle, and attentive with both of them.

The grooming was flawless — clean trims, soft coats, perfectly shaped faces, and even the little details like nails and ears were done beautifully. You can truly tell they care about the dogs and take pride in their work.

What impressed me most was how calm and comfortable our pups were afterward. No stress, no nervous behavior — just happy dogs showing off their fresh cuts. The customer service was also excellent, with great communication and genuine kindness from start to finish.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for a trustworthy, caring, and talented groomer, especially for breeds that need a little extra attention like dachshunds and schnoodles. We’ll definitely be back!
